cross_verification.note_en: A document purporting to be a scanned copy of the official REPUBLIC OF NAMIBIA, Ministry of Home Affairs and Immigration 'APPLICATION FOR VISA' form (Form 3-1/0033, under the Immigration Control Act 1993) was found, but only as an incidental reference document on a NASA field-mission logistics page (airbornescience.nasa.gov/.../namibia_visa_application%20ORACLES.pdf, for an unrelated 'ORACLES' airborne-science mission) rather than on mha.gov.na or any Namibian government/embassy channel. Per verification policy (source_url must be on a .gov/.go.xx/embassy/immigration/foreign-ministry domain of the issuing authority), a US federal science-agency subdomain does not qualify as an official Namibian source regardless of the document's apparent authenticity. All fields sourced solely from this document — size (37×52mm, which would otherwise match the DB value of 3.7×5.2cm exactly), file_spec, and official_source_url itself — have accordingly been downgraded to unverified pending a source hosted on an official Namibian government/diplomatic channel. No size, background, or head-height figure specific to na-passport (as opposed to na-visa) could be verified either — see na-passport.json.
